productivity_status: Disabled by default; retained as an optional high-level modelling assumption, not a reproduced 2023 non-agricultural estimate. Archived WDI diagnostic gives about 0.370 whole-economy and 0.385 after an approximate aggregate agriculture exclusion; OECD 0.33 is per hour with different membership and weighting. Optional transfer uses 0.32 and existing screening scenarios; see docs/PRODUCTIVITY_EVIDENCE.md.
productivity_measure: Intended proxy: LATAM/OECD non-agricultural GDP per person employed. The adopted 0.32 is an assumption. The WDI audit uses LAC excluding high-income economies, not Colombia; OECD per-hour comparisons are only plausibility checks.
productivity_time_convention: Apply the fixed ratio once to eligible yearly factors for 2024-2055; no additional calendar-year GDP growth or manufacturing multiplier.
us_jedi_money_convention: Use the two user-supplied saved runs with their shared 2010 dollar-year setting. This is a relative-transfer convention, not a verified vintage for default costs. No 2024-dollar sensitivity run has been supplied or recalculated.
solar_boundary_assumption: Direct rooftop factors use Rutovitz 2025 Table 3 construction 4.19/1.61 (about 2.602) and O&M 0.13/0.09 (about 1.444), derived from curated 2024 source rows. Construction-only ratio is a proxy for the combined I-JEDI Colombia direct construction/manufacturing anchor; no invented split. Indirect and induced retain matched US-JEDI ratios. No total-manufacturing ratio is used. Australian rooftop and US residential portfolios do not establish a Colombia-specific rooftop mix.
capacity_basis_assumption: Dimensionless source ratios are transferred to the I-JEDI anchor capacity basis without an additional DC/AC multiplier; source capacity conventions may differ and this remains a transfer assumption.
exclusions: I-JEDI Colombia and rooftop factors derived from it
Already-LATAM employment factors, including nuclear and large-hydro O&M
Global manufacturing totals and mixed construction/manufacturing totals lacking a supported split
Indirect and induced impacts; nuclear O&M; fuel and transmission factors
Unverified provenance: leave unadjusted and flag for review
